school_reopen_reason: Official FIPI 2026 EGE/OGE school content exposed six productive orthographic decisions with no semantic owner in the Rosenthal-frozen 179. Per file 260 policy, they are admitted explicitly rather than hidden inside exam overlay metadata.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Неизменяемые приставки: сохранять нормативный состав приставки и отличать приставку от корня/приставкоподобной части
canonical_units.decision_model: Identify whether the segment is an ordinary invariant Russian prefix. Preserve its lexical/morphemic spelling despite pronunciation; route Z/S prefixes, PRE/PRI and I/Y-after-prefix cases to their dedicated engines; distinguish words where the apparent prefix belongs to the root or is a historical/borrowed element.
canonical_units.ownership_boundary: school-prefix-z-s-selection, school-pre-pri-semantic-base, school-pre-pri-lexical-contrast-family, school-i-y-after-russian-prefix-base and school-separating-hard-soft-sign-boundary remain separate decisions.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Безударная гласная в суффиксе: проверяемый суффикс, устойчивый суффиксальный образец или словарный контроль
canonical_units.decision_model: If a suffix vowel is not governed by a dedicated contrast engine, verify it with the same suffix under stress where possible; otherwise recognize a stable conventional suffix pattern or use dictionary control. Individual suffix spellings such as -ИНСТВ-/-ЕНСТВ-, stable noun/adjective suffixes and similar FIPI members are branches, not separate denominator identities.
canonical_units.ownership_boundary: Specific productive contrast engines (-ЕК/-ИК, -ЕЦ/-ИЦ, -ЧИК/-ЩИК, -К/-СК, -ИВ/-ЕВ etc.) retain ownership and are not duplicated.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Гласная основы инфинитива в формах прошедшего времени, действительных причастиях и деепричастиях
canonical_units.decision_model: Establish the infinitive/source verb and preserve the relevant stem vowel before -Л-, -ВШ-, -В-, -ВШИ; when paired infinitives differ lexically/semantically (-ЕТЬ/-ИТЬ type contrasts such as obessilet/obessilit), resolve the source verb/meaning first and then preserve its vowel.
cross_links: school-gerund-forming-suffix-system owns which gerund-forming suffix pattern is used; this unit owns the stem vowel before that suffix

canonical_units.canonical_label: Суффиксы деепричастий: выбор нормативной модели по виду и основе глагола
branches: imperfective -А/-Я from the present stem where the form is normative
-ВШИ in reflexive and source-established variant contexts
-УЧИ/-ЮЧИ and special/variant forms only in their current normative/stylistic scope
canonical_units.ownership_boundary: Gerund punctuation and НЕ with gerunds remain separate punctuation/orthography decisions; the preceding stem vowel before -В/-ВШИ is cross-owned by school-verb-infinitive-past-nonfinite-stem-vowel.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Безударные падежные окончания существительных: склонение, падеж, число и проверка тем же типом окончания
canonical_units.decision_model: Determine noun declension/type, number and case; choose the regular unstressed ending or verify it by a form of the same inflectional type with a stressed ending. Route special -ИЙ/-ИЕ/-ИЯ/-ЬЕ, genitive-plural, proper-name instrumental and other difficult families to their active specialized identities.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Падежные формы и окончания числительных: базовый тип склонения и маршрут к специальным парадигмам
canonical_units.decision_model: Determine numeral structural type and case; apply ordinary case ending/inflection or route to the special paradigms for 40/90/100, -ДЕСЯТ/-СОТ compounds, collective and fractional forms and other current normative classes.
canonical_units.ownership_boundary: school-numerals-two-form-paradigm-40-90-100 and school-numerals-both-parts-decline-50-80-200-900 remain separately counted difficult paradigms; school-numeral-orthography-base owns solid/separate spelling and internal-letter patterns, not case inflection.

scope_expansions.reason: Participle case endings use the adjective-type inflectional mechanism; FIPI OGE 6.7 supplies the explicit exam/school route.

scope_expansions.semantic_scope_after: suffix/ending O/E after sibilants across applicable nominal, adjectival and adverbial positions
